start.title: Link your WhatsApp
start.description: Vera only answers the number that sends the code. Pix and payments are off limits: she only reads your data.
start.consent: To answer, Vera sends aggregated totals to a language model through a Vercel service. Names of people and merchants, transaction descriptions, accounts and credentials are never sent. I agree, and this also turns on the text summaries. You can turn it off in Settings › Data and privacy.

waiting.title: Only the message is missing
waiting.description: Send the code from your WhatsApp. This screen updates as soon as the message arrives.
waiting.pendingNoLink: You already generated a code, valid until {{time}}. To see the link again, generate another one.

linked.title: Linked number
linked.dialogText: Vera stops answering on {{phone}}, reminders created there are canceled and the conversation history leaves here. You can link again whenever you like.
